description: Numeric ratchet for Orrery. Each entry has a current value (where the engine is now) and a target (what done means). Current values start at the failing baseline and only move toward target through verified runs. Targets that are tolerances trace to SPEC.md and to a cited source; they are never fabricated, and an invariant threshold flips from pending to a real measured current only when a committed test records it.

milestonesComplete.note: All eight milestones implemented and green: primitives; two-body Kepler; classification; N-body integration; Lambert; maneuvers; patched-conic transfer with the Standish/Algorithm 8.1 ephemeris and porkchop; CR3BP with Jacobi constant and Lagrange points.

testsPassing.note: Floor target met and exceeded: every acceptance criterion across all eight milestones is demonstrated by a real test (plus an adversarial break-push suite). 148 passing, 0 todo, 0 failing.

testsTodo.note: No remaining test.todo: every milestone-2-through-8 criterion is now a real, passing test.

testsFailing.note: A break push files a failing test first, which raises this above zero until the fix lands.

nanInfOccurrences.note: Hard invariant across every milestone: no NaN and no Infinity ever appears in a state, element, or derived quantity.

splitJdRoundTripError.note: Enforced now by src/core/time.test.ts within atol 1e-6 s over +/- 200 years; exact observed maximum not separately recorded.

keplerRoundTripError.note: Enforced by src/twobody/elements.test.ts over a 10000-case grid. Measured worst over a deterministic grid: a relative 2.0e-14, angle 8.7e-14 rad (atan2-based extraction).

universalVsRegimeError.note: Enforced by src/twobody/kepler.test.ts (elliptic and hyperbolic grids). Measured worst relative state disagreement 7.0e-14 on a deterministic grid.

stumpffContinuityError.note: Enforced by src/numeric/stumpff.test.ts. Closed form and Taylor series agree to a measured worst of 6.8e-13 over |z| in [1.5e-4, 1], the cutover being the smallest magnitude meeting 1e-12.

numericVsAnalyticLeapfrog.note: Velocity-Verlet leapfrog vs analytic Kepler at h = period/1000. Second order: error is phase drift growing linearly with horizon (measured 9.1e-5 at one orbit, 8.8e-4 at ten, matching an independent Verlet reference). The 1e-4 figure is the one-orbit bound; over the full one-to-ten-orbit range leapfrog stays below 1e-3.

numericVsAnalyticRK4.note: RK4 vs analytic Kepler over ten orbits at h = period/1000. Measured worst 3.1e-9.

maxEnergyDriftLeapfrog.note: Symplectic, bounded and non-growing (max over the second half does not exceed the first). Measured envelope 1.06e-4 over 1000 orbits at h = period/200, e = 0.1.

maxEnergyDriftPEFRL.note: Fourth-order symplectic, tighter bounded band than leapfrog. Measured envelope 4.99e-9 over 1000 orbits.

linearMomentumDrift.note: Equal-and-opposite force writes hold this at machine-noise level (measured 1.9e-14 on an isolated three-body system) and exactly zero on an equal-mass binary.

angularMomentumDrift.note: Symplectic methods, bounded and non-secular. Measured worst 2.1e-14 over a 100-orbit leapfrog and PEFRL run.

replayByteIdentical.note: Enforced by src/integrators/integrators.test.ts: recordTrajectory then replayTrajectory yields byte-identical snapshot buffers for all four integrators.

lambertEndpointError.note: Enforced by src/lambert/lambert.test.ts. Re-propagating the solved velocity recovers the target position; measured worst 4.2e-12 over a deterministic single-revolution grid (both BMW and Izzo).

lambertIzzoVsBmwError.note: Two independent Lambert solvers agree on the single-revolution solution to a measured worst 4.4e-13 over the grid. (BMW Newton is damped below the z = (2 pi)^2 single-revolution branch boundary.)

earthMarsVinfError.note: Patched-conic excess speeds vs Curtis Example 8.8 (3.1651 and 2.8851 km/s), with planet states from the Algorithm 8.1 ephemeris (full precision, not the book's rounded printout). Measured worst 4.2e-6 (arrival).

lagrangeL4L5Error.note: Enforced by src/cr3bp/cr3bp.test.ts. L4/L5 are the exact closed form (1/2 - mu, +/- sqrt(3)/2); measured worst deviation plus equilibrium residual 4.7e-16 over Earth-Moon, Sun-Earth, and mu = 0.5.

collinearResidual.note: Physics residual of the converged collinear Lagrange points (not a transcribed number). Measured worst 2.95e-14 over Earth-Moon, Sun-Earth, and mu = 0.5; Newton drives each to |dOmega/dx| <= 1e-13.

jacobiDriftBound.note: Jacobi constant C = 2 Omega - v^2 under the canonical symplectic leapfrog in the rotating frame: bounded, non-secular oscillation. Measured worst relative drift 5.84e-10 over 200 nondimensional time units at h = 0.001 (an L4 libration).
